subject.title: fix(doctor): skip cleanup hints for active gateway and downgrade exec SecretRef errors to warnings

question: Should doctor-specific unresolved exec SecretRef handling use the existing explicit read-only inspection path, or may the exported strict SecretRef helper gain doctor-specific leniency controlled by process environment?
rationale: The PR touches an exported SecretRef helper and a credential failure boundary; choosing the permanent API shape and acceptable downgrade mechanism is a maintainer/security decision, not only a mechanical repair.

options.title: Use explicit read-only inspection
options.body: Keep strict exported helpers strict and move doctor/status handling onto `resolveSecretInputString` inspect-mode diagnostics before considering merge.

options.title: Approve env-scoped leniency
options.body: Allow the exported helper to downgrade exec refs during doctor, but require CODEOWNERS review, compatibility tests, and proof that runtime/plugin callers cannot inherit the downgrade.

options.title: Split SecretRef from cleanup hints
options.body: Land or replace only the cleanup-hint fix now and handle exec SecretRef doctor behavior in a separate security-owned PR.

recommendation.title: Use explicit read-only inspection
recommendation.body: Keep strict exported helpers strict and move doctor/status handling onto `resolveSecretInputString` inspect-mode diagnostics before considering merge.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS explicitly owns secret-related config files and the unresolved SecretRef behavior is the risky part of the decision.
